source:
🇬🇪 ქართული ეზო-ფერმა - Roblox თამაშის სრული ბლუპრინტი (1000 პუნქტი)
დააკოპირე მთლიანად Roblox Assistant-ში და მიეცი გენერაციის ბრძანება ქვედა ნაწილში.
🎨 UI & VISUALS (60)
Retro Stud-ტექსტურიანი ღილაკები მთავარ მენიუში
Stud-ტექსტურა ინვენტარის სლოტებზე
Stud-ტექსტურა Shop card frame-ებზე
3D ფიზიკური სიარულის character controller
Mobile touch joystick + jump ღილაკი
PC WASD + mouse-look მართვა
Gamepad მხარდაჭერა (Xbox/PS)
Camera zoom/shoulder-switch
მთავარი მენიუს ფონი - სოფლის პანორამა
Loading screen ქართული ორნამენტით
UI ფერთა პალიტრა - ბორდო/ოქრო/ყავისფერი
Custom ფონტი ქართული სტილისთვის
ღილაკის hover/press ანიმაცია
UI open/close tween ეფექტები
Inventory grid UI
Inventory slot rarity-ჩარჩო ფერები
Currency counter UI ზედა კუთხეში
XP/Level progress bar
Mini-map ეზოს განლაგებით
Mini-map player icon rotation
Notification toast - მოსავალი მზადაა
Notification toast - მუტაცია აღმოჩენილია
Notification toast - ახალი quest
Notification toast - daily reward
Settings მენიუ (ხმა/გრაფიკა/კონტროლი)
Language toggle (ქართული/ინგლისური)
Player HUD - health/stamina placeholder
Quick-access hotbar ხელსაწყოებისთვის
Dialogue box NPC პორტრეტით
Dialogue box ტექსტის typewriter ეფექტი
Shop Frame ტაბები (Seeds/Gear/Eggs/Cosmetics)
Shop item card gradient rarity ფონები
Shop item glow ეფექტი იშვიათებზე
'New!' badge item card-ზე
'Limited' badge item card-ზე
Rotating stock countdown timer UI
Purchase confirmation popup
Sell confirmation popup
Trade request UI window
Trade offer slot grid ორივე მხარეს
Leaderboard UI frame
Leaderboard player row template
Achievement/Quest log UI
Achievement completion popup ანიმაცია
Admin panel frame (dev-only access)
Admin panel weather control ღილაკები
Admin panel player-management ცხრილი
Emote wheel UI
Photo-mode UI ეზოს გადასაღებად
Friends list UI ეზოში მოსაწვევად
Tooltip system item-ებზე hover-ისას
Currency purchase (Robux) frame
Error/warning popup template
Confirmation dialog template (Yes/No)
Onboarding tutorial overlay ისრებით
First-time-player welcome popup
UIAspectRatioConstraint ყველა frame-ზე
UIListLayout ავტომატური სორტირებისთვის
Dark/Light UI თემის toggle
Accessibility - დიდი ფონტის რეჟიმი

answers.ask: How big is the yard, and how many planting plots should it hold? Three hundred crop types is listed but no plot count.
answers.answer: Keep the starting yard compact: 24 planting plots, with the layout leaving room for later expansion rather than trying to place all 300 crop types at once.

answers.ask: Is each player alone in their own yard, or are yards neighbours in one shared village?
answers.answer: Use one shared Georgian village, with each player assigned a neighbouring personal yard so players can visit, trade, and see each other’s farms.

answers.ask: What is the progression target - money, collection completion, or levels?
answers.answer: The main progression is earning currency by growing and selling crops, while crop collection completion and XP levels support that progression.

answers.ask: What is actually in the yard besides plots - house, barn, storage, fencing, animals? The list never says.
answers.answer: Each yard should have a small traditional Georgian house, a modest storage shed, wooden fencing, and the planting plots; do not add animals unless they are implemented later through the listed Eggs shop.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D game map showing a shared traditional Georgian village made of neighbouring personal farmyards that players can visit. Each compact starting yard is enclosed by wooden fencing and contains a small traditional Georgian house, a modest storage shed, and exactly 24 planting plots arranged in clear rows, with open space reserved for later expansion. Populate the plots with a varied visual mix of grapevines, orchard trees, berry bushes, vegetables, herbs, and melons representing the large collection of Georgian crops. Frame the village with a rural Georgian panorama in the background; do not include animals.
blob:
### Genre
The dominant genre is Simulation: crop growing and selling is the progression loop, expressed as a shared persistent farming world. There is no secondary genre.

### Shape and preset
Use `world-shared`. This is a single connected Georgian village of adjacent personal yards rather than isolated tycoon plots. It most closely matches the Vehicle Sim preset in its shared-world shape only; its options do not apply, so the preset is none.

### Config requirements
Use visible `path-circulation`: compact dirt or stone pedestrian lanes connect every neighbouring yard and allow farm visits. Use visible `settlement-density`: the yards form one small, built-up rural Georgian village rather than scattered farms. No other options are requested. There are no invisible layout-only components.

### Layout components
Build one compact village zone on a broad, mostly level rural surface, with a central pedestrian lane branching to a close-knit ring or grid of neighbouring, fenced personal farmyards. Each starting yard is similarly sized and enclosed with wooden fencing. Within every yard, place one small traditional Georgian house near the lane-facing edge, one modest storage shed offset beside it, and exactly 24 rectangular planting plots in clear, readable rows. Leave a contiguous open patch within or directly behind each yard for later plot expansion. Visually vary the planted rows among grapevines, orchard trees, berry bushes, vegetable beds, herb beds, and melon patches, without attempting to show all 300 crop types as separate plot varieties. Keep all paths walkable and yards visibly visitable through gates or openings in the fences. The village boundary dissolves into open rural fields and a wide Georgian countryside panorama; no animals appear anywhere. Compose the isometric view from above the central lane so multiple repeated yards, their 24-plot grids, and the mountain-and-field backdrop are legible at once.

### Render order
Use `isometric`: the pastoral visual identity, repeated fenced yards, and rural panorama lead; the simple connected pedestrian layout can be projected afterward without topology risk.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is large, driven by the shared village and multiple complete neighbouring yards, despite each individual yard being compact. Theme: warm traditional Georgian rural homestead, timber fences, cultivated earth, vines and orchards, pastoral mountain panorama. Use `P0`; all play sits on one exterior ground surface and the requested layout has no forced overhangs, interiors, separate maps, volumetric traversal, or validity-by-construction route.
